name: Night by Night
source:
It's time to go to sleep... but you hear a growl coming from under your bed. What could it be..?

[From [url=https://jovonka-johnson.itch.io/night-by-night]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
该睡觉了…可你听见床底下传来一阵低吼。那会是什么呢…？
